← All modules

The Raku ecosystem under Raku++

Every distribution in the REA index — latest release of each — fetched, built, installed and its own test suite run under Raku++.

637 of 2,524 distributions pass their own tests. A verdict names the first rung that failed, so a fix tends to move a dist one rung: pass passes its own test suite · build-fail its native build step fails · dep-build-fail a dependency’s build fails · dep-fail a dependency fails first · fetch-fail could not be fetched · other timeout / abnormal exit · self-fail its own suite fails · unresolved could not be resolved. The sweep, the fix campaign it drove, and the per-dist raw results live in the write-up; the trend is on the dashboard. The table opens most-depended-on first; click a header to re-sort, and the filter matches distribution names, authors, and the dependencies a dist is blocked by alike.

437 distributions never reach their own test suite because something in their dependency chain fails first, and 330 of those wait on more than one — a row opens to show every dependency it is stuck behind, with that dependency’s own error. Between them they wait on 552 distinct distributions. The ones the most dists wait on:  104 ·  76 ·  74 ·  72 ·  69 ·  69 ·  67 ·  67.
